verdict.rationale: Clerk documents machine credentials for agents: API keys for programmatic callers and M2M tokens for agent-to-agent calls, metered as a platform feature. Scoping comes from OAuth scoped access, custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients, and gating individual agent tool calls against the caller's permissions and scopes, all backed by custom roles and fine-grained permissions. missing for 10: explicit docs showing per-key or per-M2M-token scope/permission restriction, credential expiry and revocation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
